{{Top}}
{{Quote|I break your solitude at the bidding of my father, Bail Organa, Viceroy and First Chairman of the Alderaan system.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope (novel)">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''First Chairman''' was the title given to the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] held this title. It may have meant he chaired the [[High Council of Alderaan]].
